public.how.title: Laga bilaabo taariikhda beerista ilaa marxaladda
public.how.lead: Marxaladda badanaa gacanta ayaa lagu qoraa, waxayna ku eg tahay cusboonaysiintii u dambaysay. Halkan waxaa laga xisaabiyaa cimiladii la diiwaangeliyey, isbeddel kastana caddayntiisa waa la kaydiyaa.
public.step.1.title: Qor waxa beeralaygu ogyahay
public.step.1.body: Beeraha, qaybaha beeraha, dalagyada iyo taariikhaha beerista waxaa lagu kaydiyaa Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Soo qaado cimiladii dhacday
public.step.2.body: Heerkulka maalinlaha ah ee goobta beerta waxaa laga soo qaadaa kaydka Open-Meteo, laga bilaabo beerista ilaa maanta.
public.step.3.title: Isku dar maalmaha kulaylka
public.step.3.body: Maalmaha kulaylka koritaanka (GDD) ayaa lagu daraa iyadoo la raacayo tusaalaha dalagga. Marka xad la dhaafo, nidaamku xilliga wuxuu u gudbiyaa marxaladda xigta, sababtana wuu diiwaangeliyaa.

public.models.lead: Maalmaha kulaylka ee loo baahan yahay si dalaggu kulayl ahaan u bislaado. Qiyaasahan gacanta ayaa lagu qoray, welina tixraac ma leh.

public.about.title: Ku saabsan
public.about.heading: Ku saabsan Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis waa barnaamij lagula socdo beeraha iyo dalagyada beer ku taal Western Cape.
public.about.why.title: Sababta loo sameeyay
public.about.why.body: Marxaladaha beeruhu way duugoobaan, wax-soo-saarkana xusuus ayaa laga qoraa. Mecropolis wuxuu marxaladda ka xisaabiyaa cimilada la diiwaangeliyay. Tiro kasta waxay ka timaaddaa hawlwadeen ama il dadweyne oo magaceedu cad yahay.
public.about.design.title: Qaabka loo dhisay
public.about.design.1.body: Heat units (GDD) ayaa laga bilaabaa maalinta beerista, iyadoo la adeegsanayo kaydka Open-Meteo. Isbeddel kasta oo marxalad ah wuxuu kaydiyaa caddayntiisa: taariikhda uu dhaqan galay, wadarta GDD iyo xogta laga soo saaray.
public.about.design.2.body: Marxaladda ka dambaysa goosashada ka hor waxaa la yiraahdaa bislaanshaha kulaylka, sababtoo ah goosasho lama diiwaangelin.
public.about.design.4.lead: Tirooyinka tixraacu waa xog lagu fahmo xaaladda.
public.about.design.4.body: Waxaa lagu kaydiyaa dukumentiyo gaar ah oo leh isha, halbeegga iyo ruqsadda.
public.about.stack.title: Farsamada
public.about.stack.body: Waa ab hal bog ah oo Vite iyo React 19 ah, kuna jira Cloudflare Pages. Browser-ku wuxuu xogta dadweynaha ee Sanity si toos ah ugu akhriyaa GROQ iyo dhegeyste waqtiga-dhabta ah. Qorista iyo xogta furaha u baahan waxay maraan Cloudflare Pages Functions, kuwaas oo hubiya cookie-ga fadhiga ee saxeexan. Zod waxaa lagu hubiyaa meelaha xogtu ka gasho, Vitest waxaa loo adeegsadaa tijaabooyinka, Tailwind 4-na qaabaynta.
public.about.limits.title: Xaddidaadaha la og yahay
public.about.limits.1: Qiyaasaha nooca dalagga (heerkulka salka, heat units-ka biqilka iyo bislaanshaha) gacanta ayaa lagu qoray, welina ilo looma hayo.
public.about.limits.2: Tixraaca lupin wuxuu ka yimid HarvestStat, wuxuuna ku egyahay 2000 ilaa 2007. Gelintii bilowga ahaydna ma helin dukumenti tixraac lupin ah.
public.about.limits.3: Xogta cayayaanku waa diiwaannada GBIF ee agagaarka beerta. Waxay muujinayaan meelaha nooc lagu diiwaangeliyay meel u dhow beerta.
public.about.limits.4: Tijaabadu waxay leedahay hal gelitaan oo la wadaago iyo xaddide codsiyo oo xusuusta ku jira. Gelitaanku wuxuu qariyaa bogagga maamulka, laakiin xogta ma ilaaliyo: xogtu waa mid dadweynuhu akhriyi karo. Wuxuuse ilaaliyaa qoraal kasta.

docs.stages.intro: Xilliyadu waxay hore ugu socdaan lix marxaladood:
docs.stages.guards: U gudbid kasta shuruud bay leedahay. La beeray wuxuu u baahan yahay taariikh beeris iyo dalag; koraya wuxuu u baahan yahay xadka heat units-ka biqilka; goosashada ka hor wuxuu u baahan yahay 90% xadka bislaanshaha; bislaanshaha kulaylku wuxuu u baahan yahay in xadka bislaanshaha la gaaro; dib-u-eegistu waxay u baahan tahay sawirka cimilada xilliga iyo tixraac la helay. guide.title: Sida loo isticmaalo Mecropolis
guide.lead: Hage gaaban oo hadal fudud ku qoran. Wuxuu kuu sheegayaa waxa barnaamijku qabto, cidda loogu talagalay iyo qayb walba shaqadeeda.
guide.what.title: Waa maxay Mecropolis?
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis waa barnaamij lagula socdo beeraha yaryar iyo dalagyada. Wuxuu isku daraa diirimaadka dalaggu helay tan iyo beeristii si uu u ogaado heerka uu marayo. Wuxuu kaloo hal meel ku tusaa cimilada, ciidda iyo cayayaanka agagaarka beertaada.
guide.what.p2: Waxaa loo sameeyey beeraha Western Cape ee Koonfur Afrika, laakiin habkan waxaa laga isticmaali karaa beer kasta, gobol kasta iyo xilli kasta.
guide.who.title: Cidda loogu talagalay
guide.who.p1: Waxaa loogu talagalay qofka beeraha yaryar daryeela, sida beeraley, maamule beer ama la-taliye.
guide.who.p2: Uma baahnid aqoon kombiyuutar ama cilmi cimilo. Haddii aad bog internet furi karto, waad isticmaali kartaa Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Sababta loo isticmaalo
guide.why.1: Hal eegmo ayaad ku arki kartaa dalagga hadda la beeray, kan koraya iyo kan goosashada ku dhow.
guide.why.2: Uma baahnid inaad beer yar walba gacanta ku cusboonaysiiso. Barnaamijku dalagga isagaa heerka xiga u gudbiya marka cimiladu muujiso in waqtigii la gaaray.
guide.why.3: Wuxuu kaaga digaa dhaxanta iyo kulaylka maalmaha soo socda, iyo cayayaanka lagu arkay meel u dhow beertaada.
guide.why.4: Wax kasta oo beer yar laga qoro, sida buufin, cayayaan aad aragtay ama qoraal, hal meel ayuu taariikhdiisa kula jiraa si aad dib ugu eegto.
guide.why.5: Tiro walba waxay muujisaa halka laga keenay, si aad u ogaato waxa lagu kalsoonaan karo.
guide.heat.title: Sida barnaamijku u ogaado heerka dalagga
guide.heat.p1: Dhirtu si dhakhso ah ayay u kortaa marka ay diirran tahay, si gaabis ahna marka ay qabow tahay. Mecropolis maalin walba wuxuu tiriyaa diirimaadkan oo ah unugyada kulaylka, kuwaas oo saynisyahannadu ugu yeeraan growing degree days ama GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Maalin walba wuxuu celceliyaa heerkulka ugu sarreeya iyo kan ugu hooseeya, dabadeedna wuxuu ka jaraa heerkulka dalaggu koritaanka ku joojiyo. Inta soo hartay waa unugyada kulaylka ee maalintaas. Maalin qabow waxba kuma darto.
guide.heat.p3: Dalag walba wuxuu u baahan yahay tiro go'an oo unugyo kulayl ah ka hor inta uusan bislaan. Marka wadarta tan iyo beeristii ay tiradaas ku soo dhowaato, dalaggu wuxuu u gudbaa heerka xiga.
guide.heat.p4: Heerkulka waxaa laga helaa Open-Meteo, oo ah adeeg cimilo oo bilaash ah kana diiwaangeliya cimilada meel kasta oo dunida ah.
guide.stages.title: Lixda heer
guide.stages.intro: Dalag kasta oo beer yar kasta ku yaal wuxuu heerarkan u maraa sida ay u kala horreeyaan.
guide.stages.planning: Xilliga waa la diyaariyey, laakiin dalagga weli lama beerin.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Dalaggu wuxuu helay inta badan kulaylkii uu u baahnaa, markaa waa waqtigii goosashada loo diyaar garoobi lahaa.
guide.stages.harvested: Dalaggu wuxuu helay dhammaan kulaylkii uu u baahnaa, markaa waa inuu bislaaday. Adiga oo keliya ayaa xaqiijin kara in la goostay, sidaas darteed barnaamijku wuxuu tan ugu yeeraa bislaanshaha kulaylka.
guide.stages.review: Xilligii wuu dhammaaday, waadna dib u eegi kartaa sida uu u dhacay.
guide.stages.p2: Barnaamijku dalag walba habeen kasta ayuu hubiyaa, iyo mar kasta oo qof ku daro wax la arkay ama hawl la qabtay. Waxaad sidoo kale xilliga ka riixi kartaa Hubi hadda si isla markiiba loo hubiyo.
guide.start.title: Sida loo bilaabo
guide.start.1: Fur bogga hore. Adigoon gelin ayaad arki kartaa khariidadda cimilada, ciidda, cayayaanka iyo wax-soo-saarka beerta tijaabada.
guide.start.2: Kor ka riix Gal, dabadeed isticmaal xogta akoonka tijaabada ee lagu siiyey.
guide.start.3: Dooro beer. Tani waxay furaysaa bogga guud ee beertaas.
guide.start.4: Riix xilli si aad u aragto wax kasta oo ku saabsan dalaggaas ku yaal beertaas yar.
guide.start.5: Sanduuqa luqadda ee bog kasta korkiisa ku yaal ka beddel luqadda. Barnaamijku doorashadaada wuu xasuusanayaa marka xigta.
guide.home.title: Bogga hore
guide.home.p1: Bogga hore wuxuu muujinayaa khariidad gobolka ah oo midabkeedu tilmaamayo kulaylka dhulku helay xilligan. Wuxuu kaloo muujinayaa cimilada hadda iyo maalmaha soo socda, ciidda beerta tijaabada, cayayaanka dhowaan agagaarka lagu arkay iyo celceliska wax-soo-saarka gobolka. Uma baahnid inaad gasho si aad u aragto.
guide.dashboard.title: Bogga guud ee beerta
guide.dashboard.intro: Bogga guud wuxuu muujinayaa hal beer. Qaybihiisu sidan ayay kor ilaa hoos ugu kala horreeyaan. Sanduuqa beerta ee kore wuxuu kuu oggolaanayaa inaad beer kale u gudubto.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Kooban beerta
guide.dashboard.summary: Tirada beeraha yaryar iyo hektarrada beerta, xilliyada socda iyo dalagyada bislaaday.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Wax u baahan fiiro
guide.dashboard.alerts: Digniino gaaban, sida dhaxan ama kulayl la saadaaliyey, dalag bislaaday, xilli aan waqtigii loogu talagalay bilaaban ama cayayaan beer yar agteeda lagu arkay. Digniin walba waxay sheegaysaa waxa keenay.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Xaaladda beerta
guide.dashboard.conditions: Cimilada maanta, saadaasha, ciidda iyo cayayaanka u dhow beertan.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Horumarka xilliga
guide.dashboard.progress: Kaadh dalag walba leh oo muujinaya inta kulaylkii uu u baahnaa uu helay. Beeraha yaryar dhinac-dhinac ayaad isu barbar dhigi kartaa, liiskana waxaad u dejisan kartaa fayl jadwal ah (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Beeraha yaryar
guide.dashboard.fields: Beer kasta oo yar oo beerta ku taal, cabbirkeeda, ciiddeeda iyo dalagyadeeda.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Raadi diiwaannada
guide.dashboard.search: Ku qor hadal caadi ah waxa aad raadinayso, sida injirta ku taal sarreenka. Wuxuu helayaa waxyaabihii la arkay iyo hawlihii la qabtay ee isla macnaha leh, xataa haddii erayo kale lagu qoray.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Talooyinka
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Shaqo beer yar loo soo jeediyey, sida buufin ama bacrimin. Mid walba waad oggolaan kartaa ama diidi kartaa, marka shaqadu dhammaatana waxaad calaamadin kartaa in la qabtay.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Waxqabadkii dhowaa
guide.dashboard.activity: Liiska goorta dalag walba heer cusub u gudbay.
guide.season.title: Bogga xilliga
guide.season.intro: Xilli waa hal dalag oo hal beer yar ku yaal hal sano. Boggiisu wuxuu leeyahay wax kasta oo ku saabsan.
guide.season.top.label: Bogga korkiisa
guide.season.top: Dalagga, beerta yar, taariikhda beerista, goosashada la filayo iyo wax-soo-saarka marka aad geliso.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Heerarka dalagga
guide.season.pipeline: Lixda heer, iyadoo kan hadda la joogo la calaamadeeyey. Riix Hubi hadda si isla markiiba loo hubiyo in dalaggu heerka xiga u gudbayo.
guide.season.readiness.label: Diyaar u ahaanshaha go'aanka
guide.season.readiness: Liiska waxyaabaha barnaamijku u baahan yahay ka hor inta uusan dalagga heerka xiga u gudbin, sida taariikhda beerista iyo xog cimilo oo ku filan. Qodob walba wuxuu leeyahay Waa hagaag, Digniin ama Waa xanniban yahay. Qodobka xanniban wuxuu kuu sheegayaa waxa maqan.
guide.season.evidence.label: Caddeymaha
guide.season.evidence: Diiwaannada barnaamijku go'aannadiisa ku saleeyey, si aad u hubiso.
guide.season.propose.label: Soo jeedi talo
guide.season.propose: Soo jeedi shaqo beertan yar laga qabto, adigoo ku lifaaqaya caddeymaha xilliga. Waxay qabyo ahaanaysaa ilaa qof ka oggolaado bogga guud.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Jaantus muujinaya unugyada kulaylka oo is biirsanaya tan iyo beeristii, iyo xarriiq muujinaysa wadarta dalaggu u baahan yahay.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Ka warran haddii?
guide.season.whatIf: Tijaabi taariikh beeris oo hore ama dambe, ama xilli ka diirran ama ka qabow, oo arag sida unugyada kulaylku isu beddeli lahaayeen. Waxba lama kaydinayo.
guide.season.summary.label: Kooban xilliga
guide.season.summary: Kooban gaaban oo AI ka qoray diiwaannada xilliga. U isticmaal caawiye ahaan, diiwaannadana hubi haddii wax qaldan kuu muuqdaan.
guide.season.notes.label: Qoraallada xilliga
guide.season.notes: Qoraallo taariikh leh oo xilliga ku saabsan. Waad ku dari, beddeli ama tirtiri kartaa, waxaadna soo celin kartaa nooc hore oo qoraal ah.
guide.season.files.label: Sawirka beerta yar iyo warbixinta baaritaanka ciidda
guide.season.files: Soo geli sawirka beerta yar iyo PDF-ka baaritaanka ciidda ee shaybaarka.
guide.season.log.label: Diiwaanka beerta yar
guide.season.log: Waxaad beerta yar ku aragtay iyo wixii aad ku samaysay, sida buufin iyo magaca daawada iyo qiyaasteeda.
guide.season.history.label: Taariikhda wax-ka-beddelka
guide.season.history: Isbeddel kasta oo xilligan lagu kaydiyey iyo taariikhdiisa.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Celceliska gobolka
guide.season.benchmark: Celceliska wax-soo-saarka gobolka ee laga helay tirakoob dadweyne. Waxaa loogu talagalay isbarbardhig, mana aha wax-soo-saarka beertaada yar.
guide.season.pests.label: Cayayaanka gobolka laga helay
guide.season.pests: Cayayaanka laga soo sheegay meel u dhow beerta yar ee ku jira GBIF, oo ah kayd dadweyne oo waxyaabaha la arkay ah. Riix Soo qaado wixii la arkay si aad u hesho kuwii ugu dambeeyey.
guide.sources.title: Halka tirooyinku ka yimaadaan
guide.sources.weather: Cimilada maanta, saadaasha iyo maalmihii hore waxay ka timaaddaa Open-Meteo.
guide.sources.soil: Xogta ciiddu waxay ka timaaddaa SoilGrids, oo ah khariidadda ciidda dunida.
guide.sources.pests: Cayayaanka la arkay wuxuu ka yimaadaa GBIF, oo ah kayd dadweyne oo waxyaabaha la arkay ah.
